units.excluded_reason: This CPU pilot has no CUDA runner; cudf behavior remains outside the declared migration.
Memory downcasting intentionally changes dtypes and is separate from backend semantic parity.
Selector and human-duration parsing is shared frontend code; this pilot covers explicit columns and integer lag forms.
Custom callables, Ray parallelism and progress reporting require a separate execution and performance study.
Median and unsupported EWM keyword combinations deliberately fall back to pandas upstream; this pilot covers native mean, std and var.
Calendar offsets, timezone and DST behavior, relative bounds and selectors require a dedicated temporal contract.
